reviews.text: This game is a dark fantasy roguelite RPG where you ascend a sunken labyrinth. Manage your action points, balance severe hunger penalties, and forge deep bonds to escape the deadly Tower.
An NSFW roguelite with great gameplay! Solid plot. Fun gameplay featuring a variety of mechanics. Outstanding art style. Good H-scenes (patch required). Multiple endings. Check it out! [👑8/10]

From the skill choices to the encounter events, Labyrinthos is packed with content. It’s a polished, challenging, and deeply atmospheric RPG.
Exploring the labyrinth stays engaging thanks to hunger, corruption, and meaningful skill choices. Each run feels different, and the steady character growth keeps pulling you back.
Wonderful surprise for fans of grid-based exploration and roguelites. The dark fantasy theme is consistent and the narrative hooks you from the start.
A visual novel but with dungeon crawler type turn based gameplay. But guess whos the publisher, our favorite Shiravune, so you know you will have an 18+ patch so keep an eye on this one.
Gameplay basic but well put together, solid variety of partners, VA really good, but mosaic censored even with patch, and would be better with animated scenes.
LABYRINTHOS is a dark fantasy roguelike RPG. Ascend a dangerous tower by managing AP-based combat, hunger, and corruption levels. Feature multiple endings and New Game Plus progression.
Trapped deep underground, a protagonist must conquer sinister trials to see daylight again. This gripping, mature RPG perfectly pairs a grim dark fantasy story with explicit, intimate encounters.
